source: the winning NPC_ records of 5 plugins in the recorded load order
animalsAre: an NPC whose race, followed through the template while the Use Traits bit is set, carries the keyword ActorTypeAnimal. No race in this build carries that and ActorTypeNPC both. Reading RNAM straight off the record instead would call 1075 records animals, 727 of which are not.
yieldIs: what the death item list in INAM gives for certain: its items, following a sublist only while that sublist's chance of giving nothing, LVLD, is zero. A sublist with a chance in it is a chance and not a yield, which is what keeps the treasure lists a chest draws from out of the table.
rankedBy: the gold value of the best thing the body gives, the thresholds in RANK_BANDS at the top of the script
yield: four pairs, novice first: the least and the most of EACH thing the body gives that a hunter of that rank takes. A pair of zeroes means that rank may not work that body at all. The same shape as the ore table and the salt quarry, which gives randInt(1, 1 + tier).

ranks.novice: a body whose best part is worth up to 10 gold
ranks.advanced: a body whose best part is worth up to 25 gold
ranks.expert: a body whose best part is worth up to 75 gold
ranks.master: anything above the band before it
